# CANDIDATE: STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND_REFINEMENT

**Filed:** 2026-06-28
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new veto primitive
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND_REFINEMENT candidate proposes to merge a new veto primitive into production, which wires `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend` into the entry path. This veto blocks P-in-uptrend and C-in-downtrend trades, while allowing range or unknown trends to pass through. The goal is to capture the edge from removing wrong-way trades only, without affecting winners.

## Mechanism

The proposed mechanism involves adding a new veto block in the `engine_cli.decide_payload` function, after the `_derive_routing` step. The veto is gated on the `gate_params["structure_veto_enabled"]` parameter. The `structure_veto` function will classify the trend using `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend` and block trades that do not align with the trend.
